ui.title: PDF Page Trimmer
ui.description: Upload a PDF and select pages to delete. Your browser generates a trimmed PDF locally—perfect for removing confidential clauses, blank pages, or redundant sections.
ui.step1Title: Step 1: Select a PDF to trim
ui.step1Hint: Supports standard PDF documents up to 50MB. Drag & drop a new PDF here to replace.
ui.step2Hint: Click page numbers below to mark them for deletion; click again to deselect.
